semantics.behavior: Pure combinational addition; outputs track current inputs after combinational settling.
semantics.latency: No clock cycles or registered stages.
semantics.input_domain: All 8-bit binary patterns on both inputs.

numeric.interpretation: a and b are 8-bit two's complement integers in [-128,127].
numeric.sum: s is the low 8 bits of the exact mathematical sum (modulo 256).
numeric.overflow: 1 exactly when the mathematical signed sum is less than -128 or greater than 127.

verification.method: Independent self-checking simulation exhaustive over all 256 x 256 binary input pairs.
verification.oracle: Convert each unsigned bit pattern to an integer signed value, add in integer precision, compare low 8 bits and signed range test.
verification.comparison: Case inequality detects unknown outputs as failures.
verification.timing: Drive each pair then allow 1 ns combinational settling.
verification.bounds: Finite external compile and simulation timeouts plus a testbench watchdog.
verification.static_review: Exact interface, continuous combinational assignments, no state, explicit 8-bit sum truncation.
